How do I use it properly the very first time?
If you mean the Mini Mod and Fresh Collection we discussed, here’s a simple first-time setup:
Put the warmer on a level, heat-resistant surface, out of reach of children and pets. Place its silicone dish on top.
Add 2–3 wax melt bears from one Fresh Collection pouch to the dish. Don’t add water or oil.
Plug in the warmer and choose a timer setting. For your first try, 3 hours is a good way to see how you like the scent.
Stay in the room while it’s running, and turn it off before sleeping or leaving. Once the wax has cooled completely, lift out the silicone dish and pop the wax out when you’re ready to change scents.
No separate liner is needed—the silicone dish does that job.
